remarks: Be where all the action is in downtown Stamford! Sunny immaculate one bedroom with gleaming parquet floors, newer kitchen with stainless steel self cleaning gas range, microwave, refrigerator and granite counter with ceramic floor. Relax with a glass of wine or a cup of tea at the butcher block breakfast bar. Enjoy the vibrant downtown city life and amenities only a short stroll down the street. Updated bath with enclosed tub. Well managed mid rise community with 24/7 security surveillance. Laundry facility, reserved parking, heat, hot water & cooking gas included. Excellent credit, no pets and no smoking. Rent is paid thru Venmo, Zelle or electronic bank to bank only.
